report.summary: Parsed CLI argument definitions for add, snapshot, done subcommands and dispatch logic.

handoff.purpose: Define CLI subcommand parsers and dispatch

symbols.name: main
symbols.note: Defines argparse subparsers for add, snapshot, done; parses args and dispatches to append_event or refresh_todo_snapshot.

claims.why: The claim describes behaviour of the snapshot subcommand, but the implementation of refresh_todo_snapshot is not in this chunk.

claims.text: Mark a TODO string as done.
claims.why: The done subcommand creates a MemoryEvent with status='done' and prints the record, matching the help description.

observations.what: The snapshot subcommand has no required arguments and only calls refresh_todo_snapshot, then prints TODO_PATH.
The done subcommand requires a positional 'todo' argument and optional --summary (default 'Marked TODO done'), --repo-root, --project, --trust, --source (default 'manual').
If args.command is not one of 'add', 'snapshot', 'done', the parser prints help and exits.
